## 席位核对 · PR #34483 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T22:25Z

Head-sha: e025d4c6f6058f2c37e3bd982b2d6534f68a4685（终版 head 评论 6931208871，dev 报告 6931174353；2 个文件，+7/−2）

**结论：ACCEPT**

- **PR 形态**：`Fixes #33828`。Modify All 那一半的裁决记录（6909362597）写明，后续只欠这两处文字：ADR 那一句和 #34082 推迟的 mdx 那一行，本 PR 正好就是这两处，所以用 Fixes 关卡是对的。
- **ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 的 2026-11-15 注**：只改了加粗的引导句。
  - 引用的原话「保持现状，只给警告」与裁决记录 6909362597 逐字一致。
  - 措辞用"kept until the field-axis split (#34365)"，与 #34365 的裁决 6912661484 要求的写法一致（原文："should read as 'kept until the field-axis split'"）。
  - 这条注的其余部分没有改。
- **按代码逐句核对**（`origin/main` 上的 `superuserFieldVote`，`effective-object-permissions.ts:1056`）：
  - 任何一个权限集只要持有 Modify All（`holdsSuperuserBypass(…, 'modify')`），函数就直接返回可读、可编辑，不会去读这个集自己的行。这与 mdx 新增的"its own Modify All still reads and edits every field… its own rows included"相符。
  - View All 这条路径会先问 `declaresOwnReadMask`，自己声明了 `readable: false` 的字段就跳过、不投读票。这与"the set's own View All leaves its `readable: false` binding"相符。
- **lint 只警告、不拒绝保存**：正文给出了 `validate-security-posture.ts` 中的 severity 和 `authoring-rules.ts` 中只按 `error` 拒绝的依据，与文中"warns"一致。
- **陈旧文字扫描**：在 head 上 grep 了 `docs/`、`content/`、`skills/` 和 `packages/lint/src`，已没有"Modify All 待裁决"一类的说法。
- **Changeset**：不发版，按 `skip-changeset` 处理。两个路径都不在任何已发布包的 `files[]` 里，正文写明了。声明为 Clause-② no、Metadata-protocol none，与纯文档改动相符。
- **门禁**：dispatch-gates 推导出 50 族，全部跑过，0 NOT MEASURED。其中 `check:skill-examples` 第一次因缺前置 build 返回 exit 3，补完 build 后重跑为 exit 0，正文有读数。
- **CI**：这个 head 上 31 项成功、25 项跳过、0 红，已读。
- **Tier H**：路径是 `docs/adr/**`，按规定需要维护者亲自合并或由他授权批准。L2 由 review#2 负责，不在 L1 的范围内。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e025d4c6f6058f2c37e3bd982b2d6534f68a4685`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md + content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx
Security-touching: yes

First contract review of this PR; no earlier record on it. It is the follow-up owed after #34082 (record 6903726508 there). Read: card #33828 and every comment, ruling 6909362597, cross-link 6912701885, #34365 and its ruling 6912661484, the PR body, the net diff against `main` (2 files, +7/−2), the check-runs, and the cited code at this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set and no public-surface change. The diff is prose in one ADR note and one docs paragraph; no schema, code, skill or generated file moves. Right.
- The ADR hunk changes one span only, the bold lead of the Modify All sentence in the D2 ⑧ note of 15 November: "pending a ruling:" becomes "kept until the field-axis split (#34365), by the maintainer's ruling on the card of 2026-11-16 (6909362597, letter A), verbatim 「保持现状，只给警告」 (keep the current behaviour, warn only):". A word-level diff shows no other token of the note changed. Right.
- The docs hunk adds the own-set half to the condition under which a `readable: false` row masks a field. It states behaviour already on `main` (landed by #34082); it does not change it. Right.

### ② Semver level

Right. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold: nothing an author writes or a consumer reads changes. No changeset, with the `skip-changeset` label: neither `docs/adr/**` nor `content/docs/**` ships in a published package. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 6931174353, open question 1 (signed trailer form on the PR body): a seat matter, answered by final-head comment 6931208871 (the area rewrote the line to the relay's comment form). No contract effect.
- Open question 2 (`skip-changeset` riding the create): answered A by the tree; the diff releases nothing.
- `Fixes #33828` closes the card: ruling 6909362597 and hand-off 6912083426 name exactly these two texts as all the card still owes after #34082. Right.
- Checks at the read: 56 check-runs, 31 success, 25 skipped, none red, none pending. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build Docs`, `Check Documentation Links` and the PR-body guards are green.
- Tier H stands: `docs/adr/**` is governed and this record says `Security-touching: yes`, so the low-risk arm does not apply. The PR is a draft.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.
- Stale-text scan at this head over `content/docs`, `docs/adr` and `skills`: no "pending a ruling" left for this rule. `authorization.mdx` (FLS posture callout) and `permissions-matrix.mdx` already state the same rule and agree with the new text.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` (hit) — holds.
- Record id, card and letter: 6909362597 is on #33828 and records that the maintainer chose option A. The quoted 「保持现状，只给警告」 is byte-identical to the record. The English gloss sits outside the quotation and says what the record says: Modify All keeps its behaviour, no save is refused, the warning is the only change.
- "kept until the field-axis split (#34365)": #34365 exists, is open, and is the decision card that separates the record axis from the field axis (ruling 6912661484, letter A; View All and Modify All stop voting on fields at its step 3). Cross-link 6912701885 on the card asks for this wording and rules out "kept by design". See N2.
- The rest of the sentence, unchanged, is still true to the code: `superuserFieldVote` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`) returns readable and editable for any set where `holdsSuperuserBypass(…, 'modify')` holds, before the set's own row is read.

`content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx` — agrees with the code, clause by clause.
- "the set that declares it does not itself hold Modify All on that object": `holdsSuperuserBypass` reads the set's own entry for the object, else its `'*'` wildcard. "holds … on that object" is the same phrase the paragraph already uses for other sets, and it covers both.
- "the set's own View All leaves its `readable: false` binding": the View All path of `superuserFieldVote` skips a set whose own row declares `readable: false`, and only when the set does not hold Modify All. The sentence's first half already says the row stops binding when another set votes.
- "its own Modify All still reads and edits every field of the object, its own rows included": true, as above.
- "`security-superuser-field-mask-inert` warns on such a row": the rule id is exact (`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`). It fires only when the set holds Modify All on the row's object, with `severity: 'warning'`, and is silent beside View All alone. See N3.
- Grammar: the sentence still parses as one, condition, colon, elaboration, then the "— so protect…" tail. See N1.
- Tried to break it: a set with its own entry lacking Modify All beside a `'*'` Modify All (own entry answers, mask binds, text right); Modify All plus View All on one set (Modify All wins, text right); an omitted `readable` (never a mask, the text speaks only of `readable: false`). None contradicts the text.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

N1 (nit) — the docs sentence now runs past a hundred words and carries two "until" clauses (the muting layer, the field-axis split). "the field-axis split" is defined on no docs page; a reader has only the issue number. Two sentences would read better. No effect on what it states.

N2 (nit) — the ADR lead reads as if ruling 6909362597 set the "until the field-axis split" bound. That record says keep and warn only; the bound comes from ruling 6912661484 on #34365. The issue number is cited, so it is traceable.

N3 (nit) — the lint rule also reports an edit lock beside the set's own Modify All; "such a row" names only the `readable: false` row. True, and the paragraph is about read masks.

N4 (nit) — outside the diff: the same paragraph's older half says a mask fails when another set "holds View All" on the object. A View All set that itself declares `readable: false` on that field casts no vote. The text errs to the cautious side, and `authorization.mdx` states the exact rule.
